Fastrack Saturday Lake Ride

Santa Barbara, CA · Waterfront · Road

Fastrack Saturday Lake Ride is a road group ride in Santa Barbara, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Dolphin Fountain at Stearns Wharf. About 40–50 miles, moderate, regroups at the top of climbs.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate, regroups at the top of climbs. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @fastrack9 the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Fastrack Saturday Lake Ride group ride

Out through Summerland and up to Lake Casitas and back, 40 to 50 miles with regroups at the top of the climbs. Riders meet afterward at Handlebar Coffee near the shop. Fastrack also lists Tuesday and Thursday 7:00 am rides and the spirited Sunday Echelon ride.
